blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — GCash operator Mynt Inc. has received approval from the Philippine Stock Exchange (PSE) for its initial public offering (IPO), moving closer to one of the largest listings in the country. On Friday, Ayala Corp. and Globe Telecom Inc. said in separate statements that Mynt received the PSE’s Notice of Approval on Sept. 17 for its listing application covering up to 8.03 billion common shares, with an overallotment option of up to 1.20 billion secondary common shares.
